root_cause: Production Source Snapshot treated a Netlify linked deploy with state=error and error_message=Skipped as a fatal provider build error, so execution exited before reaching the already-authorized exact-source MCP upload fallback.
prevention_rule: Distinguish Netlify Skipped from a real failed build. For Skipped linked deploys, keep fail-closed identity checks but continue through the canonical exact-source upload transport. Real provider errors remain terminal failures.
failed_approaches: Treating every Netlify state=error identically even when error_message=Skipped indicates no provider build was executed.
Stopping before the canonical exact-source fallback despite valid OIDC/proxy transport already being available.

invariants: Skipped linked deploy never counts as production success
Skipped linked deploy reaches only the existing authorized exact-source fallback
real Netlify build errors still fail closed
